modInfo: This version was made specifically for Build 42 Stable, preserving the spirit of the original procedural world erosion overhaul while expanding and adapting it for the newer build. It includes dynamic vegetation, nature reclamation, road debris, large/JUMBO trees, and properly damaged and destroyed fences to make the world feel progressively abandoned and reclaimed by nature.

This project is made with great respect for Dane’s 10 Years Later Mod and is intended as a tribute and continuation of the ideas that made the original mod so enjoyable for us. If he wishes to take down this mod, I would happily do so.
